user.title: Connect your Vimar View Door monitor
user.description: Enter its local IP address and the numeric device password used by View Door. This uses a local connection. The certificate presented by this address during setup will be remembered for later connections. Camera support is experimental; ring alerts and two-way audio are not included.

error.invalid_auth: The monitor rejected this device password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the monitor.
error.invalid_device: Enter a local IP address and numeric device password for a supported View Door monitor.
error.certificate_changed: The device certificate changed. Verify the monitor identity, then remove and add the integration again.

abort.wrong_device: The monitor identity does not match the configured device.
